THE LITTLE DETAILS

Before you
get crafty.

Still wondering about something?
We’re a message away ↗

Do you deliver to my area?+

Yes, delivery is available across Lebanon. The store currently lists $3 for Beirut and $4 outside Beirut, with free delivery on orders above $100. Delivery usually takes 2–4 business days after an order is placed.

How can I place an order?+

Choose a product and design, add it to My picks, then send your list to Crafts Corner on WhatsApp. The team will confirm your choices, availability, final price, and delivery. You can also order from the existing online store.

How do I pay?+

Crafts Corner accepts cash on delivery in US dollars. Your order and total are confirmed with the team before dispatch.

What comes inside a DIY kit?+

It depends on your project. Product details show the materials included. For example, the Hello Adorable crochet kit includes cotton yarn, a hook, stuffing, and a pattern. Ask us if you need help choosing.

Can I exchange or return my order?+

The store’s current policy does not offer refunds or exchanges. Please confirm your design, colour, and kit details with the team before ordering.
